description: Per-character list of selectable situation-overview (profile/card view) poses; the character row's Id_SituationOverview points here.

ID.simple: Character id that owns this pose list.
ID.technical: FName row key in SituationOverviewDataTables (DTM +0xAD0), looked up from Character.Id_SituationOverview. GameItemDescriptionTextWidget uses the row id itself as the character id for a pose item's owner name. Exported ids are character codes (CP_010, CN_041, ...).

Id_SituationOverviewPose.simple: Ordered pose ids available to this character.
Id_SituationOverviewPose.technical: TArray<FName>, row +0x10. Index 0 is the default/free pose: GameCharacter_IsSituationOverviewPoseAvailable and GameUserCustomize_IsPoseAvailable return true for index 0, and any SelectedPoseIndex not found in the array falls back to 0 or is reset. Capture and model-viewer code indexes the array by the saved SelectedPoseIndex; exported rows have six slots, many ending in None.

notes: Repeated consumers: the capture actor resolves Character->Id_SituationOverview then Id_SituationOverviewPose[PoseIndex] without an index check (Source/Abrams/Private/GameCharacterCaptureActor.cpp:228-237, 621-626, 1148-1153, 1212-1213, 1260-1261, 1306-1310, 1393-1398); a missing overview or pose row aborts that capture path.
The pose tile widget only lists entries that are valid FNames and have an unlocked Item row whose VariableId is the pose id (Source/Abrams/Private/GameCustomizeCharaViewPoseTileWidget.cpp:91-121).
Row constructor is empty (Source/AbramsDataTable/Private/GameDataTableRow_SituationOverview.cpp:3). Single exported table, no shards or localization variants.

Evidence is from the reconstructed C++ in Source/ (row shape/counts from the exported table); status/ records byte matches for some owner TUs, but this file does not claim a retail byte comparison for every function or exhaustive Blueprint/runtime coverage.

usages.detail: SituationOverview-specific row finder used by the tile, view and customize-info consumers.
Pose ownership test: index 0 (or an unlisted pose) is free; all others require an owned SituationOverviewPose item matching the id.
Maps each selectable character's saved SelectedPoseIndex to a pose id for the tile widgets.
Validates and resets saved pose indices against the row's array.
Resolves the pose row used for animation, montage, weapon and shikigami setup in situation-overview captures.
Reverse lookup: finds the character that owns a pose item so its name can be shown.
